text_block_list.text:
During training, Grass Wonder got injured, 
so we came to the nurse's office to treat 
it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I apologize for causing you 
trouble."
choice_data_list:
Let's take today off and try again 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I apologize for causing you 
trouble."
choice_data_list: It was my lack of attention.

Let's take today off and try again 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true...! It isn't your 
fault at all, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's my fault. I got so focused that I 
became completely oblivious to my 
surroundings—
choice_data_list:
In that case, both of you should be 
careful.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"We are an Umamusume and her Trainer. Our 
partnership is all about making up for 
what the other lacks."

From then on, I became even more mindful 
of Grass Wonder's injuries.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. At the end of the day, it 
is my responsibility."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Just for today, I shall quietly rest...

After finishing the treatment, Grass 
Wonder headed back to her room.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. Although it feels as if my 
spirit smolders when I cannot run—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I can endure this frustration, so long as 
I consider it the seed for an even greater 
leap forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So that I can immediately make up for lost 
time once fully recovered, I shall take 
this time to recharge my energy~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... please brainstorm lots of training 
for me while you have the time♪

Although it took time to heal her injury, 
Grass Wonder threw herself into her 
training with even greater spirit 
afterwards.
